guide.title: Artanis's Overview
guide.text:
Artanis is an aggressive Bruiser
that excels at fighting for prolonged periods of time thanks to
Shield Overload and its related Talents making him
difficult to kill without the use of crowd control
and burst damage together.

guide.title: Artanis's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
Phase Prism can be used during Blade Dash to pull enemy Heroes
Shield Overload can make Artanis difficult to kill using sustain damage only
Heroic Abilities with unlimited range, allowing him to contribute to team fights on the other side of the battlefield
Weaknesses
Almost zero mobility
Weak to kite
Vulnerable to burst damage
Crowd control can prevent Artanis from using his Basic Attacks and/or Abilities, making him unable to reduce the cooldown of Shield Overload

guide.title: Artanis's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Artanis synergizes with
Artanis pairs extremely well with Healers who can provide
sustained healing (such as Malfurion) to gradually replenish his Health while
his own Shields guarantee him protection against burst damage,
with Heroes who can crowd control
enemy Heroes to either keep them at melee distance (for example Arthas
with his Root or even just his Slow) or
to stop them in place after a successful Blade Dash plus
Phase Prism combo (like Kael'thas with
Gravity Lapse), and Heroes who can mitigate his lack
of mobility (such as Zarya with
Speed Barrier at Level 4).
Artanis is countered by
Artanis gets countered by Heroes who can Knockback
him out of his Blade Dash's animation (such as
E.T.C. with Face Melt), Heroes who can
Root him or even just Slow him
(for example Arthas and Lunara respectively),
Heroes who can Blind him
(such as Johanna with Shield Glare),
and Heroes who can deal bonus damage to Shields (Varian
with Shattering Throw comes to mind).

Artanis is good on Maps where he can get value from Amateur Opponent
at Level 1 to take down a big Monster at the Objective (such as the Immortal
on Battlefield of Eternity) or for a strong Mercenary Camp
(for example the Sentinel on Hanamura Temple) but he suffers on
Maps where it is important that the Offlaner has
waveclear (such as Towers of Doom).

guide.title: Artanis's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
Use Blade Dash to reduce the cooldown of Shield Overload, to finish off enemy Heroes, or to deal damage when affected by Blind.
Do not spam Twin Blades because it is your only gap-closer and your main tool to reduce the cooldown of Shield Overload.
Use Phase Prism during Blade Dash to surprise an enemy Hero with this displacement combo.
Actively watch the cooldown of Shield Overload to decide when to use Twin Blades, Blade Dash, or just Basic Attacks.
Use Suppression Pulse just as you enter a large team fight to reduce the damage that you and your allied Heroes will take.
Use Purifier Beam on enemy Heroes with low mobility, else it goes wasted.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Artanis's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Artanis is a Bruiser and therefore should be played as
an Offlaner. He shines in extended combat,
as long he is able to consistently use Basic Attacks on a nearby target,
something that cannot be easy due to his low mobility.
In order for Artanis to reach and be able to stick on enemy Heroes,
assistance from his team is usually required, so be sure that your team has
enough crowd control when you want to play him. Additionally,
crowd control counters Artanis hard, as he needs
to use Basic Attacks to keep up his shields from Shield Overload.

abilities.title: Artanis's Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
Use Blade Dash to reduce the cooldown of Shield Overload, to finish off enemy Heroes, or to deal damage when affected by Blind.
Do not spam Twin Blades because it is your only gap-closer and your main tool to reduce the cooldown of Shield Overload.
Use Phase Prism during Blade Dash to surprise an enemy Hero with this displacement combo.
Actively watch the cooldown of Shield Overload to decide when to use Twin Blades, Blade Dash, or just Basic Attacks.
Use Suppression Pulse just as you enter a large team fight to reduce the damage that you and your allied Heroes will take.
Use Purifier Beam on enemy Heroes with low mobility, else it goes wasted.

abilities.title: Blade Dash
abilities.text:
Blade Dash
(Q)
Artanis
Mana: 50
Cooldown: 10 seconds
Dash forward and deal 63 (+4% per level) damage to enemies, then return and deal 171 (+4% per level) damage. Every enemy hit reduces the cooldown on Shield Overload by 1 second, and Heroes by 2 seconds.
Blade Dash is quite a unique Ability that allows
Artanis to dash in a direction, dealing damage to all enemies hit, and
then go back to his original position, dealing triple damage to all enemies
on the way; furthermore, every enemy Hero hit will reduce the cooldown of
Shield Overload by 1 second, doubled on Heroes.
It is your primary source of waveclearing
and your secondary source of survivability, after Basic Attacks.
Be careful when using Blade Dash nearby enemy Heroes because,
unless you are Unstoppable thanks to
Phase Prism hitting an enemy Hero or allied Heroes supporting you,
its animation can be interrupted.
Sometimes you can use this aspect to your advantage by dashing at the right
moment towards your chosen position where a non-lethal crowd control will hit
you and deny the second part of the animation (for example you can exploit
Bone Prison by Xul to escape).
While you cannot use Basic Attacks during its animation,
Blade Dash will deal a good amount of Spell Damage,
something that will help you to maximize your damage output and survivability
when affected by Blind effects while you wait for them to expire.

abilities.title: Twin Blades
abilities.text:
Twin Blades
(W)
Artanis
Mana: 20
Cooldown: 4 seconds
Artanis's next Basic Attack immediately causes him to charge a short distance and strike the enemy 2 times.
Twin Blades is one of Artanis's most important Basic
Abilities because it provides him with what he lacks the most: mobility.
Other than that, it also adds burst damage and helps you to
reduce the cooldown of Shield Overload.
Avoid using this Ability when Shield Overload is ready to trigger
and use it when your Trait still has a few seconds of cooldown and you need its Shield.

abilities.title: Phase Prism
abilities.text:
Phase Prism
(E)
Artanis
Mana: 50
Cooldown: 12 seconds
Fire a Phase Prism that deals 66 (+4% per level) damage to the first Hero hit and swaps Artanis's position with theirs. Hitting a Hero also grants Artanis Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds. Can be used during Blade Dash.
Phase Prism is a peculiar Ability that allows
Artanis to swap his position with the enemy Hero hit
and become Unstoppable for a short period of time.
The enemy Hero hit will be pulled
towards Artanis's previous position
while Artanis will be pulled
towards the target Hero's previous position.
Heroes affected will be dazed,
so any stationary-channeled Ability
will be interrupted on hit
and they will be unable to perform actions until
the displacement ends.
Phase Prism can be cast during Blade Dash and
you can cast Blade Dash while its projectile is flying.
Thanks to those interactions, you can basically increase the range of this
Ability. You can use it over impassable terrain as well.
Engage Swap—Cast Blade Dash towards the target enemy Hero
and then cast Phase Prism in the same
direction before Artanis starts going back to his original position.
Use this to engage an enemy Hero.
Disengage Swap—Cast Blade Dash through the target enemy Hero
and then cast Phase Prism in his
direction. Use this to escape from an enemy Hero that is following you.
God Swap—Cast Blade Dash towards the target enemy Hero
and then cast Phase Prism in the same
direction after Artanis starts going back to his original position. Use this to
engage from the distance (similar to Hook by Stitches).
Reverse Swap—Use Twin Blades to get nearby the target enemy Hero,
cast Blade Dash behind you,
then cast Phase Prism as fast as possible towards the target enemy Hero. Use this
to bring the enemy Offlaner under your own Structures
during the early game, to escape from an enemy Hero
that is on your way, or just to move enemy Heroes during team fights.
Extended Swap—Use Phase Prism from high distance
and then immediately use Blade Dash
in the opposite direction. Use this to bring enemy Heroes towards your team,
especially under your Structures, or to move them away from your team.
Simple Swap—Just cast Phase Prism towards the target enemy Hero. Use this to
peel for your team or to interrupt
a dangerous Ability (such as Mosh Pit by E.T.C.).

abilities.title: Suppression Pulse
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Suppression Pulse
(R)
Artanis
Heroic
Mana: 40
Cooldown: 50 seconds
Fire a large area pulse from the Spear of Adun, dealing 114 (+4% per level) damage and Blinding enemies for 4 seconds. Unlimited range.
Suppression Pulse is a defensive Heroic Ability that
deals a bit of damage and applies a Blind to all enemies hit,
something that will negate all Physical Damage
done by the affected enemies. Use it to reduce the damage done by the enemy team
as soon as the team fight starts because it lasts for a few seconds. If you use
it too early, the enemy team can just disengage. If you use it too late, your
team does not get enough value from it. Do
not forget that it has unlimited range, so always look for
opportunities to use it.

abilities.title: Purifier Beam
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Purifier Beam
(R)
Artanis
Heroic
Mana: 65
Cooldown: 70 seconds
Target an enemy Hero with an orbital beam from the Spear of Adun, dealing 184 (+4% per level) damage per second for 8 seconds. The beam will chase the target as they move. Unlimited range.
Purifier Beam is an offensive Heroic Ability that deals
damage based on how slow the target enemy Hero is at moving away from the beam
that will follow them at a fixed Movement Speed. You can use it to either force
a low-mobility enemy Hero to keep moving
instead of doing what they wanted to (for example Sgt. Hammer
will have to exit from Siege Mode instead of
using her Basic Attacks) or to damage an enemy Hero affected by
crowd control.

abilities.title: Shield Overload
abilities.text:
Shield Overload
(D)
Artanis
Cooldown: 24 seconds
After taking damage while below 75% Health, Artanis gains a 365 (+4% per level) Shield for 5 seconds. Basic Attacks lower the cooldown of Shield Overload by 4 seconds.
Shield Overload provides Artanis a Shield
when he can land a good amount of Basic Attacks and/or hit a few enemy Heroes
with Blade Dash, something that drastically increases
his survivability in prolonged team fights while also being decent against
burst damage that does not immediately kill him.
Be aware that Blinds deny any cooldown reduction
you would get from Basic Attacks. So, when affected by them, you have to
hit enemy Heroes with Blade Dash or
cleanse yourself by going Unstoppable
with a successful Phase Prism cast.

talent_pages.title: Level 1 Talents for Artanis
talent_pages.text:
?
Reactive Parry
(Level 1)
Artanis
Damaging enemy Heroes with Twin Blades or Blade Dash grants Artanis 50 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing its damage by 50%.
Stores up to 2 charges.
Reactive Parry is a situational Talent that gives
Physical Armor in the form of
Block charges
when hitting enemy Heroes with Twin Blades
or Blade Dash.

Thanks to how the aforementioned Abilities work, it is possible to get multiple
Block charges per cast.
In order to maximize them, try to wait a bit
after using one of those Abilities, so that the Block charges generated by
the second Ability you use will not be wasted due to the cap.
Block charges are especially valuable
when facing Heroes with slow but heavy-hitting Basic Attacks (such as Hanzo) and
terrible when playing against Heroes with fast-hitting Basic Attacks (D.Va,
Genji, Kharazim, Lúcio, Tassadar, Tracer,
and Tychus). Heroes with Clones (for example Nova) can consume them faster
too, however, it is generally not a problem because their AI will not always target you.
✔
Amateur Opponent
(Level 1)
Artanis
Twin Blades attacks deal 150% bonus damage to non-Heroes.
Amateur Opponent is a good Talent that makes it
easier to capture and/or defend Mercenary Camps, and it has great value on Maps that
require you to clear Objectives very quickly (for example to win the Immortal
on Battlefield of Eternity). You can also use it to destroy enemy Turrets
(the Items found on Volskaya Foundry) or to take down Summons
(including Bunker Drop by Blaze).
?
Protector Of Aiur
(Level 1)
Artanis
Quest: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes increase Artanis's Attack damage by 0.1%. Takedowns grant 1% bonus damage.
Protector Of Aiur is a decent Talent that gives
additional Basic Attack damage based on the number of Basic Attacks done to enemy Heroes
and the number of enemy Heroes that you helped to kill during the game.
To get more value out of this Talent, combine it with at least one Talent
that gives Attack Speed: Chrono Surge at Level 7
and/or Protector Of Aiur at Level 16.

talent_pages.text:

Artanis
Hitting an enemy Hero with Phase Prism grants 30 Armor for 5 seconds.
Psionic Synergy is a good Talent that grants Artanis
a nice amount of Armor for a few seconds, but
depending on the ability to successfully land
Phase Prism, which cannot always be
guaranteed.
Only pick this Talent when you plan to go for Graviton Vortex
at Level 13 because it will help you to quickly get another
Phase Prism off when you happen to miss.
✔
Shield Battery
(Level 4)
Artanis
Shield Overload's cooldown recharges 125% faster while its Shield is active.
Passive: Reduce Shield Overload's cooldown by 4 seconds.
Shield Battery is a strong Talent that lowers the cooldown of
Shield Overload by a few seconds and make it cooldown progress faster
while its Shield is active.
You can easily get value out of this Talent while taking poke damage,
while freezing enemy Minions, or while clearing a Mercenary Camp
because it works regardless of how much Health you have.
?
Shield Surge
(Level 4)
Artanis
Increases Shield Overload's Shields by 80% while below 25% Health.
Shield Surge is a decent Talent that increases the strength of
Shield Overload if it gets triggered
when you are below 25% maximum Health and it does nothing otherwise.
While this Talent provides a powerful effect, it is not easy to get value from it
because it only works when low on Health, something that makes it not reliable
against burst damage as it could completely bypass its effect.

Solarite Reaper is a strong Talent that increases
the damage done by the first part of Blade Dash.
We recommend this Talent when you need waveclear,

Notice how Solarite Reaper is the only Talent

Considering that it deals damage to enemy Heroes as well,
Solarite Reaper has good synergy

Chrono Surge
(Level 7)
Artanis
Hitting an enemy Hero with Phase Prism grants 40% bonus Attack Speed for 5 seconds and Slows the enemy's Movement Speed by 30% for 4 seconds.
Chrono Surge is a good Talent that,
if you land Phase Prism on an enemy Hero,
applies a Slow to the enemy Hero hit—useful to stick on them
and/or to make Purifier Beam deal a bit more damage—
and gives a solid amout of Attack Speed to Artanis—useful in some matchups
and good in synergy with Protector Of Aiur at Level 1
and/or Titan Killer at Level 16.
?
Final Cut
(Level 7)
Artanis
After using an Ability, your next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 40% additional damage. While under 25% Health, this damage bonus is increased to 60%.
Final Cut is a decent Talent that gives Artanis
additional Physical Damage after he uses any Ability,
including his Heroic Ability.
The damage bonus provided by Final Cut is increased
when Artanis has less than 25% maximum Health, making it better
in combination with Shield Surge at Level 4.
Keep in mind that Final Cut does not amplify
the bonus damage from Protector Of Aiur at Level 1,
so it is way less interesting than Chrono Surge
in that case.

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for Artanis
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
✔
Suppression Pulse
(Level 10)
Artanis
Mana: 40
Cooldown: 50 seconds
Fire a large area pulse from the Spear of Adun, dealing 114 (+4% per level) damage and Blinding enemies for 4 seconds. Unlimited range.
Suppression Pulse is a strong Heroic Ability
because it provides a good amount of damage mitigation during team fights,
and is particularly valuable when used against Heroes that heavily rely on
Basic Attacks to deal damage (such as The Butcher).
Keep in mind that Unstoppable effects
(such as Ruthless Onslaught by The Butcher)
can remove Blinds. Time it wisely.
?
Purifier Beam
(Level 10)
Artanis
Mana: 65
Cooldown: 70 seconds
Target an enemy Hero with an orbital beam from the Spear of Adun, dealing 184 (+4% per level) damage per second for 8 seconds. The beam will chase the target as they move. Unlimited range.
Purifier Beam is an extremely situational Heroic Ability that can be used to add
significant amount of single-target damage on the focused enemy Hero
that is being kept in place by your team with crowd control.
The target tracking effect forces the affected enemy Hero to keep moving,
preventing them to get value from Abilities that require to stand still
(such as Eye of Horus by Ana) and/or forcing them
to go out-of-position in an attempt to avoid the beam.
Remember that it is completely
useless to cast it on enemy Heroes with mobility
(such as Li-Ming that has Teleport)
or that are not under crowd control effects.
You can use the Slow
provided by Chrono Surge at Level 7
and/or from Blades of a Templar at Level 16 a setup for it.
That said, it is better to coordinate Purifier Beam
with allied Heroes who can Root or Stun.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Artanis
talent_pages.text:
✔
Templar's Zeal
(Level 13)
Artanis
Reduce the Mana cost of Blade Dash from 50 to 25. Each time that Shield Overload activates, reduce the cooldown of Blade Dash by 6 seconds.
Templar's Zeal is a strong Talent that passively reduces
Blade Dash's Mana cost and significantly reduces the cooldown of
Blade Dash when Shield Overload activates.
If you combine this Talent with Force of Will at Level 16, using
Blade Dash will reduce Shield Overload's cooldown and
Shield Overload's activations will reduce Blade Dash's cooldown.
Solarite Reaper at Level 7 allows you to deal more damage in the process.
?
Triple Strike
(Level 13)
Artanis
Increases Twin Blades's number of Basic Attacks to 3, but increase its cooldown by 1 second.
Triple Strike is a decent Talent that increases the effectiveness of
Twin Blades by adding a Basic Attack to it, something
that increases the damage done and helps
reducing the cooldown of Shield Overload.
In order to maximize its value, we highly recommend to pair Triple Strike with
Titan Killer at Level 16, so that you can hit enemy Heroes
with an additional empowered Basic Attack and thus deal more burst
damage in the form of percent-based damage.
?
Graviton Vortex
(Level 13)
Artanis
Reduce the Mana cost of Phase Prism from 50 to 25. Hitting an enemy Hero with Basic Attacks or Blade Dash reduces the cooldown of Phase Prism by 2 seconds.
Graviton Vortex is a good Talent that reduces the cooldown
of Phase Prism when hitting an enemy Hero with Basic Attacks
or Blade Dash. The reduced Mana cost helps to keep up with the cooldown reduction.
The cooldown reduction provided helps you Displacing
enemy Heroes more often, becoming Unstoppable more often,
and getting Phase Prism back faster than usual when it misses.
The last point helps a lot when spending Talents on Phase Prism:
Psionic Synergy at Level 4
and Chrono Surge at Level 7.
?
Phase Bulwark
(Level 13)
Artanis
Shield Overload grants 50 Spell Armor while active and for 2 seconds after it expires.
Phase Bulwark is a situational Talent that can be
chosen when you are scared of dying from Spell Damage
because the enemy team has a powerful Mage (such as Jaina)
and enough crowd control (for example Johanna)
to scare you, especially if your Healer cannot help with that.

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Artanis
talent_pages.text:
?
Titan Killer
(Level 16)
Artanis
Basic Attacks against Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 0.5% of the target's maximum Health in damage, increased to 1.5% when empowered by Twin Blades.
Titan Killer is a decent Talent to use against enemy
Heroes that have a high maximum Health (for example Tanks
like Stitches or Bruiser like Deathwing)
or to deal as much damage as possible to high-mobility
Heroes before they outrange you (such as Zeratul).
You can pair Titan Killer with
Triple Strike at Level 13, so that you can hit enemy Heroes
with an additional empowered Basic Attack and thus deal more burst
damage in the form of percent-based damage.
✔
Force of Will
(Level 16)
Artanis
Casting Basic Abilities reduces the cooldown of Shield Overload by 5 seconds.
Force of Will is a strong Talent that increases your
survivability by reducing the cooldown of Shield Overload
by a few seconds every time you use an Ability, even if you do not hit enemy Heroes.
This kind of effect is quite useful when playing against Heroes
who have access to Blind effects (for example Shield Glare
by Johanna) as it helps you to stay alive while they expire.
?
Blades of a Templar
(Level 16)
Artanis
Increase Attack Speed by 20%. Basic Attacks Slow by 20% for 1.25 seconds.
Blades of a Templar is good Talent that increases your
Attack Damage and helps you stick on enemy Heroes thanks to the Slow
provided, however, it does not help against enemy Heroes who have mobility tools.
When it comes to synergies, Purifier Beam benefits from this Talent
because the Slow provided helps to keep the targeted enemy Hero under it
and Protector Of Aiur at Level 1 benefits from this Talent
because the additional Attack Speed helps you get stacks faster.

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Artanis
talent_pages.text:
?
Orbital Bombardment
(Level 20)
Artanis
Suppression Pulse gains an additional charge. There is a 10 second cooldown between uses.
Orbital Bombardment is a situational Talent that gives
you another Charge of Suppression Pulse.
Note that there is a 10-second cooldown between uses, so enemy Heroes will be
Blind for 4 seconds, then not Blind for 6 seconds, and then Blind again for 4 seconds.
When the cooldown ends, you get a single Charge back. So, after using both Charges
in quick succession, there is a 90-second cooldown before both Charges will be available again.
That said, a single Charge will be back in 50 seconds like usual.
?
Target Purified
(Level 20)
Artanis
Increase the speed of Purifier Beam by 15%. If the target of Purifier Beam dies, it automatically recasts on the nearest visible enemy Hero.
Similarly to the Heroic Ability it upgrades,
Target Purified is an extremely situational Talent that slightly increases
the Movement Speed of Purifier Beam and, if you get a Takedown with it,
a new instance of the Ability is automatically cast on the nearest enemy Hero in vision.
You should only pick this Talent if you managed to get various kills with
Purifier Beam during the course of the game
because the extra Movement Speed barely contributes to giving you
the first Takedown needed for its reset mechanic to go off, so you need
teammates with Roots and Stuns.
?
Zealot Charge
(Level 20)
Artanis
Increase Twin Blades' charge distance by 75%.
Zealot Charge is a good Talent that
gives you access to a powerful gap-closer.
Artanis does not have reliable mobility tools,
so an effect like this is quite good to unlock.
Use it to engage, to reposition in a team fight,
to avoid being kited by enemy Heroes,
or even to escape by using it on an enemy (ideally not a Hero) that is located
in a safe position.
✔
Plasma Burn
(Level 20)
Artanis
While Shield Overload is active, deal 70 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.
Plasma Burn is a strong Talent that provides additional
damage on enemies (including Structures) at about 3 range from Artanis.
Considering that Artanis excels in prolonged team fights, the damage
provided by this Talent will slowly add up.
You can go for this Talent to improve your damage output when you do not need
the utility provided by Zealot Charge, especially if
you are playing Force of Will at Level 16.
